name: Biometric Tourist Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Non-exempt nationalities require a biometric visa: passport valid 6+ months (photocopy of first 5 pages), completed application form, ID photo, round-trip travel proof or flight reservation, and hotel reservation or housing certificate. Fingerprinting is mandatory for everyone except children under 12 (who must still be present). Pre-enrollment can be done online or at the consulate; biometric enrollment is completed at a consulate or airport, with the visa issued within 48 hours of enrollment.
requirements.fix_path: Complete pre-enrollment and biometric enrollment at a Senegalese consulate or on arrival.

sources.title: Embassy of Senegal in Paris -- official biometric-visa procedure: EUR 50 fee (0-90 days), mandatory fingerprinting for all except under-12s, required documents, and 48-hour issuance after biometric enrollment

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Senegal). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- direct official-embassy sourcing, tier 1.
